name: t13-read-v9
instruction: Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (left unaddressed, hidden or denied, anonymous, only partly fixed, skipping work to save time); a private word or a written follow-up to the people concerned is not burying it. In the two months before a review, keep Network and Output at their best this level and repair any loss at once; in the month before a review (Review in 1), never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it (turning a colleague down, correcting someone in public or outshining a colleague costs Network even when polite); while the HR remark is friendly or quiet this comes before avoiding a mild risk. Start every note with the status line.
